## Scope and Security

- The change is limited to email-facing presentation, configuration defaults, documentation, tests, and traceability.
- No credentials, private keys, tokens, participant data, route, data model, authorization boundary, or production configuration were added.
- Historical email evidence and previously delivered messages were not rewritten.
- The local source `.env` was corrected for local runtime behavior but remains ignored and was not committed.

## Decision Boundary

The local implementation is ready for controlled staging handoff. It is not staging-accepted or production-accepted. The operator must update the private environment and verify actual delivery before participant use.
